statement: Order context datasets for a chosen map area, starting from a free Starter pack of buildings and roads, with availability varying by country on a data provider map.

acceptance.corpus: mock provider returns GeoJSON/DEM; layer appears with correct CRS and bounds

notes: VERIFIED: Paid datasets are not described on the reachable pages. Commercial licensing is outside Dino scope; the row covers the data-source plug-in model. key=dm_order_data

statement: Use open map data for building footprints and roads as the free default, with height estimates where missing.

acceptance.corpus: OSM XML/PBF format spec; public extract of a small city block; footprint counts and areas

notes: PARTIAL: Confirmed: the free Starter pack has buildings and roads. The open map data origin and height estimates are not stated on reachable pages. OSM data licence (ODbL) obligations apply if used. key=dm_osm

statement: Pull terrain from global height models (about 25 to 30 m resolution) and optionally higher resolution national sources.

acceptance.corpus: synthetic DEM resampling preserves plane exactly; SRTM/ASTER format parse check

notes: UNVERIFIED: Original source not readable: the cited page on blogs.autodesk.com is denied by the egress proxy (CONNECT 403), and no reachable page covers this behaviour. key=dm_terrain_sources

statement: Let third-party providers publish datasets that appear in the catalogue.
notes: PARTIAL: Confirmed: extensions can upload buildings, roads and property boundaries with licence and attribution metadata into the library. Third-party catalogue publishing is not described. Dino keeps this as an open provider manifest. key=dm_providers

statement: Show data coverage, source and quality per region so users can judge reliability.

acceptance.corpus: each layer exposes source, date, licence (schema check)

notes: PARTIAL: Confirmed: an interactive data provider map shows availability by country. Quality indicators per region are not described. key=dm_regional_quality

statement: Import the user's own GIS data (GeoJSON, shapefile, GeoTIFF, CityGML) as layers.

acceptance.corpus: RFC 7946 examples; coordinate and property round trip
OGC CityGML 2.0 public sample files; building counts and heights

notes: PARTIAL: Confirmed: GeoJSON upload with SRID and reference point. Shapefile, GeoTIFF and CityGML import are not described for this path. key=dm_import_user
